column1: Entering or exiting martial mode requires {n} turns. During the transition, and for as long as the mode is active, Cogmind movement speed is halved and the exoskeleton cannot be disabled or removed. While in martial mode, will automatically use an active melee weapon to attack any hostile that moves into an adjacent position at {n}% of the normal time cost (no follow-ups). Also a {n}% chance to use the melee weapon to deflect each incoming projectile, with a second melee weapon adding {n}%, and an additional {n}% for each after that. For example, three melee weapons have a collective {n}% chance to deflect each projectile. Melee weapons successfully deflecting projectiles in this manner have a {n}% chance to take {n} damage each time. While in this mode, Cogmind is also immune to knockback and cancels out all recoil from firing ranged weapons. Activate the exoskeleton a second time to begin changing its martial state.
column2: 进入或退出武术模式需要{n}回合。转换期间以及模式生效期间，Cogmind的移动速度减半，外骨骼无法停用或卸下。武术模式下，任何敌对单位移动到相邻位置时，都会自动使用有效近战武器攻击，耗时为常规值的{n}%（不会追加攻击）。此外，每次来袭投射物都有{n}%概率被近战武器偏转；第二把近战武器额外增加{n}%，之后每多一把再增加{n}%。例如，三把近战武器合计有{n}%概率偏转每枚投射物。以此方式成功偏转投射物的近战武器，每次有{n}%概率受到{n}点伤害。此模式下Cogmind还免疫击退，并抵消远程武器射击的所有后坐力。再次激活外骨骼即可开始切换武术状态。

column1: Remaining total amount of integrity capable of restoring during repairs. When instructed to AID an ally Mechanics enter repair mode, in which they attempt to repair (in priority order:) that ally, or Cogmind, or the closest ally in need of repairs. Repair prioritizes robot cores, broken parts, restoration of missing functionality, followed by part integrity. Field repairs on the latter are only capable of restoring a part up to {n}% integrity. Repairs cannot be made while either the target is in combat or the Mechanic itself is taking fire. Mechanics are not capable of repairing Cogmind's core. For keyboard users there is a shortcut to simultaneously order all visible controllable Mechanics to AID, by pressing 'r' once in order mode.
column2: 维修时可恢复的耐久总量。收到“协助”盟友的指令后，机械师会进入维修模式，按优先级尝试维修该盟友、Cogmind，或最近的待修盟友。维修优先顺序为机器人核心、损坏部件、恢复缺失功能，最后是部件耐久。对最后一项进行战地维修时，部件耐久最多只能恢复至{n}%。目标处于战斗中或机械师自身遭受攻击时，无法维修。机械师无法修复Cogmind核心。键盘用户可在命令模式中按一次“r”，同时命令所有可见且可控的机械师执行协助。

column1: Burnout represents the rate at which this propulsion's integrity will deteriorate while overloaded, indicated as a percent chance per move to lose one point of integrity. Overloading boosts performance: speed is calculated as if there is two of this part active at once, support is increased {n}%, energy costs doubled, and heat generation tripled. If moving at the normal maximum speed for the current propulsion type, each overloaded hover/flight unit further reduces final movement time by {n}, to a value no better than {n}. If N/A, this propulsion cannot be overloaded; in general only cooled hover and flight units support overloading. Activate an applicable propulsion a second time to overload it.
column2: 过载损耗表示此推进部件过载时耐久恶化的速率，以每次移动损失1点耐久的概率百分比表示。过载可提升性能：速度按同时启用两个此类部件计算，支撑力提高{n}%，能量消耗翻倍，热量产生变为三倍。若以当前推进类型的正常最高速度移动，每个过载的悬浮/飞行单元还会使最终移动时间减少{n}，最低不低于{n}。若标为N/A，则此推进无法过载；通常只有冷却型悬浮和飞行单元支持过载。再次激活适用的推进部件即可使其过载。

column1: Entering or exiting siege mode requires {n} turns. During the transition, and for as long as the mode is active, Cogmind is immobile and the treads cannot be disabled or removed. While in siege mode, non-melee attacks have +{n}% accuracy, coverage for all armor and heavy treads is doubled, any treads in siege mode get a free {n}% damage reduction, no weapons suffer from recoil effects, and Cogmind is immune to instant part destruction from critical hits. Treads capable of High siege mode instead give +{n}% accuracy and have {n}% damage resist. Activate siegable treads a second time to begin changing their siege state.
column2: 进入或退出攻城模式需要{n}回合。转换期间及模式生效期间，Cogmind无法移动，履带也无法停用或卸下。攻城模式下，非近战攻击命中率增加{n}%；所有装甲和重型履带的覆盖权重翻倍；处于攻城模式的履带免费获得{n}%伤害减免；武器不受后坐力影响；Cogmind免疫暴击造成的部件瞬间摧毁。可进入高级攻城模式的履带则改为提供{n}%命中率加成和{n}%伤害抗性。再次激活可攻城的履带即可开始切换攻城状态。

column1: Impact weapons have a damage-equivalent chance to cause knockback, and ignore coverage thus are effective at destroying fragile systems. By ignoring coverage, there is an equal chance for an attack to hit any given part, where each slot of a multislot part also has a separate and equivalent chance to be hit. A target's core also counts as one slot for that purpose. For every component crushed by an impact, its owner's system is significantly corrupted (+{n}-{n}%), though electromagnetic resistance can help mitigate this effect. (Cogmind is less susceptible to corruption caused in this manner.)
column2: 冲击武器造成击退的概率与其伤害等值，并忽略覆盖权重，因此擅长摧毁脆弱系统。忽略覆盖权重后，攻击命中任意部件的概率相同；多槽部件的每个槽位也各自拥有相同的独立命中概率。目标核心也计作一个槽位。每个被冲击粉碎的组件都会使其所属机器人的系统严重损坏（+{n}-{n}%），但电磁抗性可减轻此效果。（Cogmind较不易受到此类系统损坏。）

column1: Chance for this weapon to instantly destroy the hit component, or even a robot core. (Cogmind is less susceptible to this effect, which can only destroy those parts which are already below {n}% integrity when hit.) Armor is immune to this effect, instead taking an additional {n}% damage. On smashing a part, an equal amount of damage is then applied as overflow damage, although unlike regular overflow damage this may be absorbed by any shielding protecting the secondary target.
column2: 此武器击中组件后使其瞬间摧毁的概率，甚至可能摧毁机器人核心。（Cogmind较不易受此效果影响；且只有被击中时耐久已低于{n}%的部件才可能被摧毁。）装甲免疫此效果，改为额外承受{n}%伤害。部件被粉碎时，还会造成等量溢出伤害；但与常规溢出伤害不同，这部分伤害可能被保护次级目标的任何护盾吸收。

column1: While active, modifies constructs and expands or builds new ones if empty power, propulsion, or weapon slots are available, if enough resources have been collected. Activate a second time to begin automatically collecting useful parts at current location to generate resources. While in COLLECT mode, visible parts suitable as resources flash on the map. Toggling that mode on also temporarily displays its current list of contained resources.
column2: 启用期间会改造已有构造；若有空置的动力、推进或武器槽，且收集到足够资源，也会扩建或建造新构造。再次激活即可开始自动收集当前位置的有用部件以生成资源。在“收集”模式下，可用作资源的可见部件会在地图上闪烁。开启该模式时，也会暂时显示当前所含资源的清单。

column1: Electromagnetic weapons have less of an impact on integrity, but are capable of corrupting a target's computer systems. Anywhere from {n} to {n}% of damage done is also applied as system corruption. (Cogmind is less susceptible to EM-caused corruption, but still has a damage% chance to suffer {n} point of system corruption per hit.) EM-based explosions only deal half damage to inactive items lying on the ground, but can also corrupt them.
column2: 电磁武器对耐久的影响较小，但能够损坏目标的计算机系统。造成的伤害中有{n}%至{n}%还会转化为系统损坏。（Cogmind较不易受到电磁损坏，但每次命中仍有伤害百分比的概率受到{n}点系统损坏。）电磁爆炸对地面上未启用的物品只造成一半伤害，但也能损坏它们。

column1: Provides a cumulative {n}% chance to temporarily trick any common 0b10 combat robot system encountering hostiles on the depth above this one into believing it is allied with Cogmind. After {n} turns the network will perform an automated quickboot to restore it to normal, a process which takes anywhere from {n} to {n} turns. The effect is less likely to occur on the depth above that (only {n}% chance), and is capped at {n}%.
column2: 累计有{n}%概率暂时欺骗任何常见的0b10战斗机器人系统：当它们在上一层遭遇敌人时，会误以为自己与Cogmind结盟。经过{n}回合后，网络会自动快速重启并恢复正常，此过程需要{n}至{n}回合。再上一层触发该效果的概率较低（仅{n}%），且最高为{n}%。

column1: Entering or exiting shielding mode requires {n} turns. During the transition, and for as long as the mode is active, Cogmind is immobile and the leg cannot be disabled or removed. While in shielding mode, coverage for this leg is doubled, and it gains a {n}% chance to glance each incoming projectile that would otherwise hit it, instead taking no damage. Activate the leg a second time to begin changing its shielding state.
column2: 进入或退出护盾模式需要{n}回合。转换期间及模式生效期间，Cogmind无法移动，腿部也无法停用或卸下。护盾模式下，此腿的覆盖权重翻倍，并有{n}%概率擦过原本会击中它的来袭投射物，从而免受伤害。再次激活此腿即可开始切换护盾状态。

column1: Stability represents the ability of this weapon to fire while overloaded without suffering any negative side-effects. Overloading doubles damage and energy cost, and generates triple the heat. If N/A, this weapon cannot be overloaded; only some energy weapons support overloading. While overloaded, heat transfer is one level higher than usual where applicable. Activate an applicable weapon a second time to overload it.
column2: 稳定性表示此武器过载射击时避免负面副作用的能力。过载会使伤害和能量消耗翻倍，并使热量产生变为三倍。若标为N/A，则此武器无法过载；只有部分能量武器支持过载。过载时，适用情况下热量传递等级会比平常高一级。再次激活适用的武器即可使其过载。

column1: Coverage is a relative indicator of how likely this part is to be hit by a successful incoming attack compared to other attached parts. For example, a part with {n} coverage is twice as likely to be hit as another part with a value of {n}. Armor, protective, and large parts tend to have higher coverage values while small subsystems provide less coverage but are therefore less likely to be damaged.
column2: 覆盖权重是相对指标，表示此部件与其他已装配部件相比，被成功来袭攻击命中的可能性。例如，覆盖权重为{n}的部件，被命中的概率是数值为{n}的另一部件的两倍。装甲、防护部件和大型部件通常覆盖权重较高；小型子系统覆盖权重较低，因此较不容易受损。

column1: Mass is shown as the total of all attached parts vs. what the currently active propulsion modules can support. Being overweight slows movement by a propulsion-specific amount for each degree that total mass exceeds the ideal limit. Overweight flight propulsion loses its dodge bonus and ability to move over non-allied bots, and all forms of propulsion always trigger traps while overweight.
column2: 质量显示所有已装配部件的总质量，以及当前启用的推进模块可支撑的质量。超重时，总质量每超过理想上限一个单位，移动就会按推进类型对应的幅度变慢。超重的飞行推进会失去闪避加成和飞越非盟友机器人的能力；任何类型的推进在超重时都会触发陷阱。

column1: Enter any combination of numbers and/or letters to "seed" the game, making it possible to replay the same world, or play the same one as friends using the same seed. (Setting this only affects future games.) Seeds are not case sensitive. Enter "{n}" or clear the seed to make it random, ensuring a new world every game. Random or not, each run's score sheet contains its seed.
column2: 输入任意数字和/或字母组合作为游戏“种子”，即可重玩同一个世界，也可与使用相同种子的朋友游玩同一世界。（此设置只影响之后开始的游戏。）种子不区分大小写。输入“{n}”或清空种子即可随机生成，确保每局都是新世界。无论是否随机，每局计分表都会记录其种子。

column1: Depending on its composition, some structures may be more or less likely to be affected by a certain type of damage. Negative resistances represent a weakness, and therefore greater damage from that source. For example, {n}% resistance would decrease the damage from an incoming attack of that type by {n}%, while {n}% would instead increase the damage sustained by {n}%.
column2: 根据构成材料不同，某些结构受特定类型伤害影响的程度可能更高或更低。负抗性表示弱点，因此会受到该来源的更多伤害。例如，{n}%抗性会使来自该类型攻击的伤害降低{n}%；而{n}%则会使所受伤害增加{n}%。

column1: Depending on their design, some installations may be more or less likely to be affected by a certain type of damage. Negative resistances represent a weakness, and therefore greater damage from that source. For example, {n}% resistance would decrease the damage from an incoming attack of that type by {n}%, while {n}% would instead increase the damage sustained by {n}%.
column2: 根据设计不同，某些设施受特定类型伤害影响的程度可能更高或更低。负抗性表示弱点，因此会受到该来源的更多伤害。例如，{n}%抗性会使来自该类型攻击的伤害降低{n}%；而{n}%则会使所受伤害增加{n}%。

column1: Depending on their design, robots may be more or less likely to be affected by a certain type of damage. Negative resistances represent a weakness, and therefore greater damage from that source. For example, {n}% resistance would decrease the damage from an incoming attack of that type by {n}%, while {n}% would instead increase the damage sustained by {n}%.
column2: 根据设计不同，机器人受特定类型伤害影响的程度可能更高或更低。负抗性表示弱点，因此会受到该来源的更多伤害。例如，{n}%抗性会使来自该类型攻击的伤害降低{n}%；而{n}%则会使所受伤害增加{n}%。
